remove_definitions(
    -DWINVER=0x502
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(
    -DWINVER=0x600
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

add_definitions(
    -D_WINE)

spec2def(wininet.dll wininet.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_library(wininet_inflate OBJECT inflate.c)
add_dependencies(wininet_inflate psdk)

add_message_headers(UNICODE winineterror.mc)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# wininet.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wininet-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(wininet_shims OBJECT inflate.c cookie.c dialogs.c ftp.c gopher.c http.c internet.c utility.c netconnection.c urlcache.c)
target_link_libraries(wininet_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libcrypt32 libmpr libshlwapi libshell32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libws2_32 libnormaliz libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(wininet_shims)
add_dependencies(wininet_shims winineterror)
add_cargo_module(wininet wininet-cargo wininet.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wininet_shims psdk)
